prompt:
Create a 2 minute 30 second instrumental event piece about a vortex ring forming and traveling. Around 110 BPM, B minor. Bass clarinet swirls a circular figure; a filtered-noise whoosh is the puff; mallets strike a clean ring when the torus stabilizes. Fluid and sudden, then strangely stable. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no lyrics, no hummed melody-as-voice, no singing, no whispered speech. No brass fanfare, no water-splash sample comedy.

[00:00–00:18] Inhalation of noise, no pitch yet.
[00:18–00:50] Bass clarinet coil; soft kick as the puff; stereo spins once.
[00:50–01:30] Mallet ring locks the torus; motion becomes forward, not spinning-in-place.
[01:30–02:10] Ring travels, slightly wobbling; clarinet long tones.
[02:10–02:30] Diffusion: ring loses edge and fades.
